tasks.name: OR של ההרשאות
tasks.src: l=>l.reduce((a,b)=>a|b,0)
tasks.note: Merged permission flags: bitwise OR fold over the list, 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: שעות נוספות מעל 10
tasks.src: l=>l.reduce((a,x)=>a+Math.max(0,x-10),0)
tasks.note: Overtime: sums the hours above 10 of each day (x-10 when positive), which tops out at exactly 15.

tasks.name: מעברי זוגיות
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++) if((l[i]^l[i-1])&1) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts neighbouring pairs whose parities differ (an even next to an odd); fewer than 2 elements gives 0.

tasks.name: לוקרים במקומם
tasks.src: l=>l.filter((x,i)=>x===8+i).length
tasks.note: Counts positions i whose element is exactly 8+i, i.e. lockers holding their own number.

tasks.name: חשבון מתחלק לשניים?
tasks.note: Returns 15 if the total bill (up to 92) is even so two people can split it exactly, else 0; empty is 15.

tasks.name: היום בשבוע בסוף
tasks.src: l=>l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)%7
tasks.note: Starting on day 0 and waiting each element's number of days in turn, returns the weekday reached: the total mod 7.

tasks.name: נסגר בשיא?
tasks.src: l=>l.length&&l[l.length-1]===Math.max(...l)?15:0
tasks.note: Did the stock close at its high: 15 if the last element is the maximum, else 0 (empty gives 0).

tasks.name: מעל השפל
tasks.src: l=>l.length?l[l.length-1]-Math.min(...l):0
tasks.note: How far the latest price (last element) is above the lowest price seen; 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: הלפני אחרון
tasks.src: l=>l.length>1?l[l.length-2]:0
tasks.note: Element at the second-to-last position; 0 when the list has fewer than 2 elements.

tasks.name: הטוב מבין 3 האחרונים
tasks.src: l=>l.length?Math.max(...l.slice(-3)):0
tasks.note: Best of the last three games: maximum over the final window of up to 3 elements; 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: מקום של 12 בתור
tasks.src: l=>{ const i=l.indexOf(12); return i<0?15:i; }
tasks.note: 0-based position of the value 12 in the queue, with 15 as the not-found sentinel.

tasks.name: חריגה מקצובה של 11 לפריט
tasks.src: l=>Math.max(0,l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)-11*l.length)
tasks.note: Allowance of 11 per item: how far the total (up to 92) exceeds 11 times the item count, 0 if within budget (cheap items offset expensive ones).

tasks.name: זוגות במרחק 2
tasks.src: l=>l.filter(x=>l.includes(x+2)).length
tasks.note: Counts value pairs {x, x+2} that are both present, regardless of position (seats with exactly one seat between them).

tasks.name: שני המחירים הקרובים
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); let m=15; for(let i=1;i<s.length;i++) m=Math.min(m,s[i]-s[i-1]); return m; }
tasks.note: Smallest absolute difference between any two values (closest pair of prices); fewer than 2 elements gives 0.

tasks.name: מה אחרי השיא
tasks.src: l=>{ const i=l.indexOf(Math.max(...l)); return i>=0&&i+1<l.length?l[i+1]:0; }
tasks.note: The element right after the maximum; 0 when the maximum is last or the list is empty.

tasks.name: עקוב אחרי המצביע
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const j=l[0]-8; return j<l.length?l[j]:0; }
tasks.note: Indirect indexing: uses the first element minus 8 as a position and returns the element there, 0 if out of range or empty.

tasks.name: הקרוב ל-12
tasks.src: l=>{ let b=0, d=99; for(const x of l){ const e=Math.abs(x-12); if(e<d||(e===d&&x<b)){ d=e; b=x; } } return b; }
tasks.note: The value closest to the target 12, preferring the smaller value on a tie; 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: ערכים בין הקצוות
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 0; const a=Math.min(l[0],l[l.length-1]), b=Math.max(l[0],l[l.length-1]); return l.filter(x=>x>a&&x<b).length; }
tasks.note: Counts elements whose value lies strictly between the first and the last element's values; fewer than 2 elements gives 0.

tasks.name: ממוצע נע של 3
tasks.src: l=>{ const w=l.slice(-3); return w.length?Math.floor(w.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/w.length):0; }
tasks.note: Moving average: floor of the mean of the last up to 3 elements (sum up to 42 internally); 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: גל חום
tasks.src: l=>{ let b=0,c=0; for(const x of l){ c=x>=12?c+1:0; if(c>b) b=c; } return b; }
tasks.note: Heat wave: length of the longest contiguous run of elements that are at least 12.

tasks.name: לפי הקלף הראשון
tasks.src: l=>l.length?(l[0]%2===0?Math.max(...l):Math.min(...l)):0
tasks.note: Conditional aggregate: the maximum if the first element is even, otherwise the minimum; 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: קבוצות מושבים
tasks.src: l=>l.filter(x=>!l.includes(x-1)).length
tasks.note: Counts the separate blocks of consecutive values present (each x whose x-1 is absent starts a block), regardless of position.

tasks.name: ציון שופטים
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<3) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b).slice(1,-1); return Math.floor(s.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/s.length); }
tasks.note: Judges' score: drop the highest and the lowest, then floor of the mean of the rest; fewer than 3 elements gives 0.

tasks.name: מיקום סגן האלוף
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 15; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); return l.indexOf(s[1]); }
tasks.note: 0-based position of the second-largest element in the original order; 15 when there are fewer than 2 elements.

tasks.name: רשימת זיגזג?
tasks.src: l=>{ for(let i=2;i<l.length;i++) if((l[i]-l[i-1])*(l[i-1]-l[i-2])>0) return 0; return 15; }
tasks.note: Returns 15 if the list alternates up and down at every step (no two consecutive moves in the same direction), else 0; fewer than 3 elements gives 15.

tasks.name: יומיים רצופים הכי טובים
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 15; let b=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(l[i]+l[i+1]>l[b]+l[b+1]) b=i; return b; }
tasks.note: Start index of the neighbouring pair with the largest sum (first one on ties), sums 17..29 internally; 15 when fewer than 2 elements.

tasks.name: נקודת חצי המשקל
tasks.src: l=>{ const t=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); let s=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ s+=l[i]; if(2*s>=t) return i; } return 15; }
tasks.note: First index where the running total reaches at least half of the whole total (weighted median position); 15 for the empty list.

tasks.name: חלוקה הוגנת לשניים?
tasks.src: l=>{ const t=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); if(t&1) return 0; for(let m=0;m<(1<<l.length);m++){ let s=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) if(m>>i&1) s+=l[i]; if(2*s===t) return 15; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Partition test: 15 if the items can be split into two groups with equal totals (subset search over sums up to 92), else 0; empty gives 15.

tasks.name: מים כלואים
tasks.src: l=>{ let w=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ const a=Math.max(...l.slice(0,i+1)), b=Math.max(...l.slice(i)); w+=Math.min(a,b)-l[i]; } return Math.min(15,w); }
tasks.note: Trapped rain water: treating elements as wall heights, sums min(max to the left, max to the right) minus the height at each position, capped at 15.

tasks.name: דראפט נחש
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); let d=0; s.forEach((x,i)=>{ d+=(i%4===0||i%4===3)?x:-x; }); return Math.abs(d); }
tasks.note: Snake draft: players pick from the largest down in the order A,B,B,A,A,B,B,A; returns the absolute difference of the two teams' totals.

tasks.name: המשחק המעגלי
tasks.src: l=>{ const a=[...l]; let i=0; while(a.length>1){ i=(i+1)%a.length; a.splice(i,1); } return a.length?a[0]:0; }
tasks.note: Josephus game: in a circle starting at the first element, every second remaining element is removed until one is left; returns the survivor (0 if empty).

tasks.name: העברות לסוף למיון
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); let k=0, p=-1; while(k<s.length){ const j=l.indexOf(s[k]); if(j<p) break; p=j; k++; } return l.length-k; }
tasks.note: Minimum number of elements to move to the end of the list so that it becomes ascending (n minus the longest run of smallest values already in order).

tasks.name: תת-סדרה עולה ארוכה
tasks.src: l=>{ const d=[]; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ d[i]=1; for(let j=0;j<i;j++) if(l[j]<l[i]&&d[j]+1>d[i]) d[i]=d[j]+1; } return d.length?Math.max(...d):0; }
tasks.note: Length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence (not necessarily contiguous); empty gives 0.
